name: dune-meter
summary: Cost-aware Dune adapter: estimate (probe heuristic) / run (cost-capped + CostAtom) / budget. The EXP-002 budget-blowout made structurally impossible.

exit_codes.2: caller error (bad args, missing key, malformed target)
exit_codes.4: cap aborted (Dune cost-cap hard-abort, or reported spend over --cap)
